Dear Cobalt Industrial,

Thank you for revising your quotation to 12.95 USD per unit with a 9-day lead time.

As we work to finalize this order for 2,000 units of Product X, we would like to ask if you could offer 12.06 USD per unit with a 7-day lead time. This pricing and delivery schedule would enable us to proceed quickly.

Please let us know if you can accommodate this request.

Best regards,
ProcureAI Demo Buyer
